title: 12 Best Shan Noodles in Mandalay
description: The best Shan noodles in Mandalay — curated from Reddit reviews and travel blogs. Shan Ma Ma, Unique Mandalay, Pan Cherry & more. Interactive map included.

places.name: Shan Ma Ma (ရှမ်းမမ)

redditQuotes.text: Shan Ma Ma is the go-to. Lemon chicken, Shan noodle soups with great spice add ons. Wonderful service.
Shan Ma Ma is a Mandalay institution. You'll see locals and tourists packed in at all hours. The noodles are consistently good and the prices are absurdly cheap.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Restaurants in Mandalay guide

redditQuotes.text: A warm, delicious, and flavorful Shan noodle is a true Mandalay favorite. Try Unique Mandalay Tea Room whenever you're in Mandalay.
In our Mandalay, Shan noodles are eaten morning, noon, and night. At Unique Mandalay you can get chicken, pork, pork ribs, and beef balls — mix and match as you like.

places.name: Pan Cherry Noodle House & Café (ပန်ချယ်ရီ)

redditQuotes.text: Pan Cherry Noodle House has stood the test of time, recently celebrating its 40th anniversary. The humble shop belies the intricate flavors and textures of their signature Shan noodles.
redditQuotes.source: — Myanmore · Serving Mandalay's best noodles since 1978

redditQuotes.text: Countless tourists have made Pan Cherry a daily pit stop on their Mandalay itinerary — they come once for a meal and find themselves returning the next day and the next!

places.name: Mogok Daw Shan Noodle (မိုးကုတ်တော်)

redditQuotes.text: I recommend the Shan noodle with meatball, dry. The noodle is so fresh with egg smell, every bite you can feel the juice from it, this is one of the best meals we had in Myanmar.

Good street corner restaurant in Mandalay. It's very cheap and the food is tasty. It's an open air restaurant with mostly local people there. We had a tea leaves salad, a crispy pork noodle soup and dumplings. Everything was very good.

places.name: 999 Shan Noodle Shop (၉၉၉ ရှမ်းခေါက်ဆွဲ)

redditQuotes.text: Arguably the best Shan noodles outside of Shan State. Traditional Burmese noodle recipe — fresh daily-made noodles served in a range of soups and sauces at very affordable prices.
The Shan Noodle with Oil was so tasty. The noodles had the smooth chewy texture reminiscent of Chinese hand-pulled noodles. The pork and 'oil' toppings were just right.

places.name: Lashio Lay (လားရှိုးလေး)

redditQuotes.text: A handful of Shan restaurants have set up shop around this intersection. Lashio Lay offers sizeable buffet spreads of standard Myanmar dishes like chicken curry and assorted sautéed greens, served with big helpings of white rice.

places.name: Golden Shan / Shwe Shan (ရွှေရှမ်း)

redditQuotes.text: We went to Shwe Shan for buffet because I was really hungry. It feels like eating chap chye peng — you pick your own favorite dishes. I had more than 10 dishes on my plate. The buffet is only 4000 kyat and the standard of the food is very good!
redditQuotes.source: — Miss Tam Chiak · 10 Must-Try Mandalay Street Food

redditQuotes.text: The lady spoke fantastic English and was very helpful in introducing the dishes! Many of them have Chinese influence and have flavourful taste profile.
redditQuotes.source: — Miss Tam Chiak · Mandalay food guide

places.name: Shwe Muse Shan Noodle (ရွှေမူဆယ်)

redditQuotes.text: Best noodles I've ever taken. Authentic Shan flavour.
Shwe Muse Shan Noodle is a popular spot in Mandalay known for its authentic Shan cuisine. The restaurant offers a variety of traditional dishes with strong and interesting flavours.
Teashop Karaweik does excellent Shan noodles and sweet naan straight from the tandoor, best enjoyed alongside a cup of tea.

places.name: Shwe Pyi Moe Tea Shop (ရွှေပြည်မိုး)

redditQuotes.text: Shwe Pyi Moe Tea Shop, a very famous breakfast stop for all Burmese. Shan noodles are served everywhere, at all hours of the day, and it is equally filling but more tangy. The toss of peanuts, fresh cilantro, onion and preserved vegetables makes it light enough to keep me full and happy, yet craving for more.
redditQuotes.source: — Miss Tam Chiak · Must-Try Mandalay Street Food

redditQuotes.text: This no-name stall along Street 16 sells excellent Myee Shay which draws a huge crowd. For only US$1, you get a bowl of rice noodles full of ingredients including pig's tail and pig's skin, plus a super flavourful bowl of pork ribs soup.
redditQuotes.source: — Miss Tam Chiak · Must-Try Mandalay Street Food

redditQuotes.text: Mandalay myi shay — the rice noodles are served with chicken or pork and topped with a generous blob of sticky glutinous rice 'glue'. It was slimy and did not look appealing initially, but once mixed in with the rest of the noodles, it actually tasted pretty good.
redditQuotes.source: — Life After 9 to 5 · Eating in Mandalay

redditQuotes.text: Burmese, Indian, and western dishes pack the vegetarian menu at this Sri Lankan family place. Most come here for lunch and dinner, snagging coveted seats on the upper-level balcony.
Tea Leaf Salad at Marie Min Vegetarian Restaurant — totally unique and utterly delicious.
redditQuotes.source: — Gallop Around the Globe · Cuisine of Myanmar
